message: Field 'mass' of Dynamic must be greater than 0 and finite, but the value is 0.0.
Field 'linear_damping' of Dynamic must be at least 0 and finite, but the value is -1.0.
Field 'angular_damping' of Dynamic must be at least 0 and finite, but the value is -0.5.
Every component of field 'size' of BoxCollider must be greater than 0 and finite, but the value is vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0).
Field 'friction' of BoxCollider must be at least 0 and finite, but the value is -0.1.
Field 'restitution' of BoxCollider must be between 0 and 1, but the value is 1.5.
Field 'mass' of Dynamic must be greater than 0 and finite, but the value is -2.0.
Field 'radius' of SphereCollider must be greater than 0 and finite, but the value is 0.0.
